_meta.description: Hand-editable answer schedule. `overrides` maps a calendar date (local time, YYYY-MM-DD) to a locality id from data/localities.json. Any date without an entry falls back to a deterministic day-index rotation through data/localities.json (in the order committed there): dayIndex = floor((date - epoch) / 86400000), answer = localities[dayIndex mod length]. See README.md / AGENTS.md for details.
